description: Defines classes and methods for managing F1-U gateway bearers and their connection in a co-located setup, including CU and DU bearer classes, and a local connector for linking them.

classes.name: f1u_gateway_cu_bearer
classes.description: Represents a CU F1-U gateway bearer, managing UL and DL TEIDs, notifiers, and connection state.

classes.name: f1u_gateway_du_bearer
classes.description: Represents a DU F1-U gateway bearer, handling UL and DL TEIDs, notifiers, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: f1u_local_connector
classes.description: Connects DU and CU-UP F1-U bearers in a co-located setup, managing creation, removal, and address retrieval.

methods.name: create_cu_bearer
methods.description: Creates a CU F1-U bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: attach_dl_teid
methods.description: Associates DL TEID info with the connector.

methods.name: disconnect_cu_bearer
methods.description: Removes CU bearer connection based on UL TEID.

methods.name: create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates a DU F1-U bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: remove_du_bearer
methods.description: Removes a DU bearer based on DL TEID info.

methods.name: get_du_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address for a given GNB DU ID.
